description: Marketplace for coworking spaces, private offices and flexible workspace across Europe, with a free Office Price Index showing current workspace prices by city.
notes: Company: CoworkingView, Berlin, Germany. Contact: Carlos Javier Müller González. CoworkingView is a Berlin-based online marketplace that helps companies, startups and freelancers find coworking spaces, private offices and flexible workspace across European cities. Users compare spaces by location, price and amenities and send enquiries directly. CoworkingView also publishes a free Office Price Index with current flexible office prices by city.
